heading: Training & Coaching
intro: We run practical training based on clinical mental health practice. Our mission is to empower managers to support their teams early, before problems build up.
body:
Our courses give managers skills they can use straight away, from spotting the signs that someone is struggling to pointing them towards the right support. We also help organisations look at the wellbeing services they already offer and make them work better.

Sessions mix case studies with group discussion and time for personal reflection. The focus is on why people struggle at work and what a manager can actually do about it. We adapt each course to your organisation and the people in it.

Good wellbeing support and well-trained managers can mean fewer mental-health-related absences and better staff retention. It can help with recruitment, too. And people who feel supported tend to think more highly of the place they work.

cards.title: Wellbeing Services Training
cards.description: Foundational training for whole organisations and teams. We cover what good wellbeing services look like, and how to understand what your staff need and encourage them to use the support available.

cards.title: Training for Managers & HR
cards.description: For anyone who manages or supports people. We'll cover supportive conversations, reasonable adjustments, return-to-work procedures, signposting and how to tell when someone is struggling at work.

cards.title: Reflective Practice & Coaching
cards.description: A regular, facilitated session where teams or individuals can drop in for advice or talk through something difficult. It works well as a follow-up to other training, too.

checklistItems.text: Recognising the signs that someone is struggling
Opening a supportive conversation and effective listening
Risks to the wellbeing of a workforce
Preventing burnout in others and yourself

quote: "In 2024/25, over 900,000 workers experienced work-related stress, anxiety or depression – resulting in the loss of 22.1 million working days."

faqs.question: Who is this for?
faqs.answer: Any organisation, and people who manage other people. We have delivered training across many sectors, from media to manufacturing, with groups of all sizes.

faqs.question: Is it delivered on-site or remotely?
faqs.answer: Either. On-site tends to work better for interactive sessions with smaller groups, but remote makes it much easier to reach people in different locations.

faqs.question: Can training be combined with therapeutic support?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it often is. Several organisations use us for both: training for managers and confidential counselling for staff. The two stay separate, and we never share anything from therapy sessions with the employer.

faqs.question: How is it priced?
faqs.answer: Per session or as a package, depending on scope. Get in touch with a rough idea of audience and format and we'll send an outline of the training and a quote.
